# asherin

> asherin is a subscription research workspace. speaker: asherin. two seats: asherin at $18/month, asherin pro at $79/month. monthly, USD, no free trial. a team workspace is billed separately. enterprise on request.

what a signed-in seat can open today: chat (the mouth), asherinx.eng (public-index search — not a wiretap), asherin.maps (satellite globe, public-agency cameras, public-index property file), asherin.defender (owned-device defence), asherin.arvision (camera intelligence HUD on this device), library, projects, memory, guardian vault, whiteboard, connect, team (pro).

you can bring your own model key — gemini, openai, claude, mistral, xai grok, groq, deepseek, openrouter, venice — and pay that vendor directly.

## honest limits

- asherin reads live public sources and cites them. when it does not find one, it says so.
- asherinx.eng can watch a public leak index for an email, phone, or handle you type. it does not intercept login IPs, SMS, DMs, or private mail.
- asherin.maps uses public agency stills and public registers. it does not hijack doorbell or flock cameras, and satellite tiles are near-daily mosaics, not live seconds.
- forecasts are probabilistic. they are not predictions of record.
- nothing here is legal, medical or financial advice.
